ladder.label: BOTTOMING
ladder.why: A new cycle low likely formed 24 day(s) ago (2026-05-13 @ 349.5): swing low in, price back above the 10-day average — but the weekly timeframe hasn't turned yet, so conviction is partial.
ladder.next: Either wait for the weekly to turn, or size half until it does.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 14 · daily cycle day 31).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): bottoming. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — a headwind on the odds
Macro-risk: aggregate macro risk elevated for a macro-sensitive name — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: The daily turn is already in — a low formed ~24 day(s) ago @ 349.5 and price is back above the 10-day average. What's missing is the weekly timeframe confirming, so this is a partial-conviction entry available now, not a pending trigger: take a half position here, or wait for the weekly to turn.
entry.text_zh: 日线转向已经完成——低点于约 24 天前形成 @ 349.5，且价格已重新站上 10 日均线。尚缺的是周线周期的确认，因此这是当下可用的部分信心入场，而非待触发信号：可在此建半仓，或等待周线转向。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 31 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: approaching the window where lows usually form
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 31 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 接近低点通常形成的时间窗口
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 14 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 14 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.next_zh: 可等待周线转向，或在其转向前先建半仓。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：筑底中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.macro_line: Macro-risk headwind: aggregate macro risk is elevated and this is a macro-sensitive (cyclical) name — buy setups here have historically taken deeper drawdowns, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. A risk/sizing caution, not a forecast.
ladder.macro_line_zh: 宏观风险逆风：总体宏观风险偏高，且该标的对宏观较敏感（周期性）——在此环境下买入形态历史上回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是风险/仓位提示，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ BOTTOMING signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-15), switching from NEARING A HIGH. Signal strength: mild (score +32/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 筑底中信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-15），自接近高点切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 +32/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid buy setting up (+45)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健买入构筑中（+45）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
